104: That is at the time of the completion of its work - and now is the time of the completion of its work. The baraita is referring to after the completion of its work, when [a worker] is not allowed to eat; for example, if the fig cakes have been spread out [to dry].
One who weeds - [at this point,] we assume that [this refers to] one who is uprooting those [garlic and onions] which are not good.
